name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A style guide and ruleset that teaches an AI coding tool to produce clean, professional-looking UI designs instead of generic or ugly default layouts.
buyer: A solo indie developer or no-code founder building their own product's UI with an AI coding assistant, with no design background.
business_use_cases: A non-designer founder uses it so their AI-built landing page looks like it was made by a professional designer instead of a generic default layout.
A freelance developer offers 'AI-assisted design polish' as an add-on service, using the ruleset to guarantee consistent visual quality.
An agency bakes it into its internal AI-coding template so every client project starts from a visually coherent baseline instead of bootstrap-default styling.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium design-language packs (minimal SaaS, playful consumer app, enterprise dashboard) as one-off purchases to indie developers.

steal_this: Build and sell a 'make my AI-coded app look good' one-time service this weekend: run a client's repo through the ruleset and ship a visually upgraded version.
